note: What a server sends to lay out a champion's standing figures. The run holds one figure after another, ordered by the name each figure is known by, compared letter by letter. Which figures a champion has is settled before a match and is not recorded here, so the run cannot be read from the wire alone.

fields.name: size
fields.note: How many bytes this shape occupies, counting these four.

fields.name: values
fields.note: The figures themselves, in the order their names sort. Each is read by the kind its name is known to carry: four bytes for a whole number or a measure, one for a yes or no, eight for a wide whole number, and for text two bytes of length and that many bytes after, with nothing closing it.
